Therapists
Our EHR software includes integrated telehealth, a robust template library, and helpful insurance tools, making it easy for you to manage your practice while caring for clients.

Easily manage your calendar, simplify billing, and run engaging in-person and virtual sessions. With SimplePractice’s HIPAA-compliant software, you can run your practice with peace of mind.

Manage patient medications and keep medical information secure with ePrescribe. You can also enjoy more flexibility with customizable rate tables and treatment plans.
